$comment: ACL role templates for the SwagCommerceAgentTools Admin MCP tools. Create roles with these privilege lists under Settings > Users & permissions > Roles (or via POST /api/acl-role) and assign them to the integration or user that authenticates against /api/_mcp. The privilege names in 'agent_change:*' are checked by the tools; the 'swag_agent_staged_change:*' privileges are enforced by the DAL on the ledger rows; product privileges cover the live write on apply.

agent-change-viewer.description: Read staged changes and analytics; cannot stage, apply or discard.

claude-merchant-agent.description: The merchant agent's integration: reads analytics, stages changes with dry-run preview. It must NOT hold agent_change:update, so it can never apply its own proposals.

agent-change-approver.description: Human approver (or approval portal integration): lists, applies and discards staged changes.
